title: TCG:Starter Deck
summary:
The Starter Deck was a 2-player beginners' expansion pack for Secrets and Seekers, the first set of the Huntik Trading Card Game. The box contained two 30-card decks with two exclusive foil cards, these being Caliban: Dante's Titan and Gar-Ghoul: Gothic Terror.
It also included a 21-card mission pack featuring 7 mission cards, a Mission Map, a Seeker Training Manual, and a bonus DVD consisting of the Huntik TCG Tutorial and Episode 1 - "A Seeker Is Born". Several of the other cards included were exclusive to this deck.

full_text:
The Starter Deck was a 2-player beginners' expansion pack for Secrets and Seekers, the first set of the Huntik Trading Card Game. The box contained two 30-card decks with two exclusive foil cards, these being Caliban: Dante's Titan and Gar-Ghoul: Gothic Terror.
It also included a 21-card mission pack featuring 7 mission cards, a Mission Map, a Seeker Training Manual, and a bonus DVD consisting of the Huntik TCG Tutorial and Episode 1 - "A Seeker Is Born". Several of the other cards included were exclusive to this deck. 

==Exclusive Cards==
The following hero cards were only available with the Starter Deck. 

*SAS-001 - Caliban: Dante's Titan
*SAS-032 - Gar-Ghoul: Gothic Terror
*SAS-037 - Janus Knight: Dark Charger
*SAS-052 - Enderby: Casterwill Tutor
*SAS-071 - Springer: Trapspringer
*SAS-078 - Bellona: Lion Gladiator

In addition, all 21 cards in the Mission Pack were exclusive to the Starter Deck.
